Dense coral corridors (8-12 m sightlines); eel holes; Needler Mk I, workbench, Locker spot 1; the moray-grouper pair; blacktip packs
A giant coral head: cleaning station on top (calm zone), tide mill = power in the surge channel; Speed Brine; anthias cloud; iguanas graze the shallows
A one-way current between the Bommie and the Wall: ride it (4 s) or trap it (1,000: flushes the Bommie's top and anything on it)
Winding corridors of brain and table coral with three Reacher gates; Flechette and Carbine racks; Deadeye Brine; titan triggerfish nests; the Raiders' inland route
The open expanse: seagrass meadows, garden eels, rays, bobbit worms, dugongs; Long Speargun, Bolt Harpoon, Double Shot; no cover, full sightlines
A nesting shallows reached from the Lagoon; the drum's quest altar; sea grape; Kick Brine; hammerheads come here for turtles at night tides
A sinkhole in the flats: ledges spiral down; the Pressure Forge on the 40 m ledge; mantas and the hammerhead spiral through; Mule Brine
The wall: dolphins, seals, whales, grey reef sharks, the Matriarch's pod; Locker spot 2; Widow's Ink; the Raiders' turtle-riders' entry from the blue

column1: Training loop (inner): Lagoon -> Staghorn Forest (S1) -> Bommie crest -> Mangrove drift -> Lagoon. About 2 min; sharks can't follow through S1's anemone row without breaking coral (loud).
Training loop (outer): Bommie -> Surge Channel (4 s ride) -> Wall -> Sand edge -> Flats -> Maze mouth -> Maze (B4) -> Forest gate -> Bommie. 5 min; crosses every apex lane once.

Blood flow: the tide runs Lagoon -> Forest -> Flats -> Wall on the ebb and reverses on the flood every 4 minutes (the tide mill shows which). Blood on the Flats reaches the Wall and its sharks in 40 s on the ebb.

Sightlines: corridors 8-12 m; Bommie top 25 m; Flats 60 m+; Wall 40 m vertical. Alarm regions: Reef (Lagoon, Nursery, Forest, Bommie, Maze) and Open (Flats, Beach, Hole, Wall); the Raiders enter at the Wall by turtle and inland by B4.
Coral erosion: each crown-of-thorns eats one staghorn segment per 90 s; a broken segment turns a corridor into a lane sharks can use. Shark rams also break segments (2 noise).
The dolphin pod follows the divers' centroid at 20-30 m while allied; rams any shark that enters 10 m of a diver; turns hostile for the match the moment a dolphin takes damage from a diver.
